about: ROFLY 효과음을 ElevenLabs Sound Effects 로 만들 때 쓰는 문구 (generate.py 가 읽음). Nick(11-28): 용량이 커지면 안 되고, 흥미나 현장감에 꼭 필요한 소리만 만든다. 그래서 짧게 만들고 다듬을 때 모노로 줄이며, 엔진음은 반복 소리 하나를 굉음·웅웅 두 겹이 높이를 달리해 같이 씀. config 는 코드에서 이 소리를 쓰는 자리, use 는 들리는 때.

sounds.name: Engine
sounds.prompt: Powerful rocket engine thrust heard from inside the spaceship cabin, deep rumbling roar with soft crackle, steady and continuous

sounds.name: EngineLoud
sounds.config: Engine 의 다른 안 (고르면 Engine 자리에 씀)
sounds.use: 비행 내내 엔진음, 노트북·폰 스피커에서도 잘 들리게 중음을 살린 안
sounds.prompt: Loud roaring rocket thruster blast, crackling exhaust with airy hiss over the rumble, steady and continuous

sounds.name: Launch
sounds.prompt: Rocket engine ignition and liftoff, explosive blast and whoosh rising into a powerful roar, punchy cartoon game sound effect

sounds.name: Caught
sounds.prompt: Huge explosion shockwave slamming into a spaceship, deep boom with metal debris, cinematic game sound

sounds.name: Countdown
sounds.prompt: Single short digital countdown beep, clean bright tone, game interface

sounds.name: MissionSuccess
sounds.prompt: Bright cheerful success chime, short sparkling arcade reward jingle, game interface

sounds.name: Combo
sounds.prompt: Energetic ascending combo chime with a punchy hit and sparkle, arcade power up, game interface

sounds.name: ItemUse
sounds.prompt: Sci-fi power up activation, energy charging whoosh with bright shimmer, game booster sound

sounds.name: Coin
sounds.use: 비행 중 코인이 들어올 때 (빠르게 여러 번)
sounds.prompt: Single bright coin pickup ting, short sparkling metallic chime, game coin collect

sounds.name: LevelUp
sounds.use: 내 부품 레벨업 (초반엔 비행 내내 자주, 갈수록 드물게. 오랜만에 오르면 크게)
sounds.prompt: Quick magical level up chime, short rising sparkle arpeggio ending on a bright bell ding, light and satisfying, mobile game reward
